candidate_reports.remark: A Trained Spotter reported a strongly rotating funnel extending halfway from the base of the cloud towards the ground.
At 5:00 PM PDT September 4_ 2026_ a funnel cloud was observed with a thunderstorm around 3 miles northeast of Sheridan_ Oregon. The exact location of the observed funnel cloud is approximated.
Gusts of 58 mph or higher were measured from 1:32 am through 1:52 am.
Isolated gusts greater than 75 mph were observed at 230 am and 12:30 pm.
Measured gusts at or above 58 mph from 4:10 am to 4:20 am (10 min.).
Sustained winds of 40 mph began at 430 am. Gusts of 58 mph ended at 830 am.
This station started recording sustained winds of 40 mph or greater at 6:08 am. Gusts of 58 mph or higher ended at 7:38 am.
Sustained winds of at least 40 mph began at 430 am.
Wind gusts of 58 mph or higher began at 8:10 am and ended at 10:05 am.
Gusts of 58 mph or higher began at 8:11 am and ended at 9:11 am. The period of the Non-Tstm Wnd Gst report was 1 hour.
